name: Momo Challenge hoax
description: The 'Momo Challenge' was a 2018-2019 internet hoax and media-driven moral panic alleging that a sinister character named 'Momo' contacted children via WhatsApp and YouTube and instructed them to perform self-harm; investigators, platforms and child-safety organisations found no evidence of any such challenge.

aliases.name: Momo
aliases.region: Used as the avatar image of the hoax

origin: Global, on the English-language internet, with substantial coverage in Latin America, India, Europe and North America.
